entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  RSI 1h = 30.6 -> +29 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone
  RSI divergence (1d) = bearish -> -35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  Bollinger position = 35% of band -> +23 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  resistance proximity = 24.6% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  RSI daily = 54.0 -> +1 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone
  distance to EMA20 = -0.09% -> +1 (weight 1.8) - Price 116.20 vs EMA20 116.31

  weighted sum / total weight (8.5) = +8.1 -> WAIT
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
